narrative.intro: This ranking shows year-over-year growth in federal contract obligations for FY2027 to date. Total obligations in this snapshot are $1.7B. Other Computer Related Services is the fastest-growing market at 19.5%, followed by Couriers and Express Delivery Services at 13.6% and Analytical Laboratory Instrument Manufacturing at 9.9%. The list highlights markets that gained the most momentum in federal buying during the fiscal-year-to-date window. Current-year totals are partial, so use this snapshot to compare relative movement between markets rather than to infer full-year outcomes. The ranking reports changes in contract obligations for the same period year over year and focuses on where federal obligations increased most in the available data window.

sections.heading: Which markets posted the strongest growth?
sections.body: Other Computer Related Services grew 19.5%. Couriers and Express Delivery Services grew 13.6%. Analytical Laboratory Instrument Manufacturing grew 9.9%.

sections.heading: How should contractors use this ranking?
sections.body: Use the ranking to identify sectors with rising federal demand in the fiscal-year-to-date window. Compare the 19.5%, 13.6%, and 9.9% growth figures to prioritize outreach and pursuit activity based on recent momentum.

faq.q: What are the fastest-growing federal contract markets?
faq.a: The fastest-growing federal contract markets are Other Computer Related Services, Couriers and Express Delivery Services, and Analytical Laboratory Instrument Manufacturing. Other Computer Related Services grew 19.5%, Couriers and Express Delivery Services grew 13.6%, and Analytical Laboratory Instrument Manufacturing grew 9.9%.

faq.q: How is market growth measured here?
faq.a: Market growth here is measured as year-over-year change in contract obligations for the same fiscal-year-to-date period. Total obligations in this snapshot are $1.7B and current-year totals are partial.
